items.html: And the benefit of the ascent — its matter is to renew those souls, and to give them power, and to shine in them. And the matter of this renewal is what renews and corrects his Mochin, which is the aspect of his soul that sits in the brain, as is known. And likewise ZA and his Nukva, the sons of AVI, ascend in the secret of MAN upward into AVI, in order to renew their Mochin and to add illumination in them. And this ascent is what is called the second Ibur of the Mochin of birth. And understand this.
